note: D9. 5.2 to 6.6 mm SL (322 to 517 hpf through the growth table). Each fin's first outline is the fold's outline over the fin's base u range (dorsal 0.58 to 0.72, anal 0.60 to 0.80, caudal 0.95 to 1.2); the fold between the fins fades out.

D9. 5.9 to 9.6 mm SL (420 to 853 hpf). The adult stripes 1D and 1V (one record, melanophore stripe ZFA:0001463) take the lateral larval stripe's u range and v; metamorphic melanophores appear as a new array at 5.9 mm SL.
D9 develops-from row. The bud ends at 60 hpf in ZFA; the fin blade is distinct by long-pec. The pectoral fin is ZFA:0001161 (spec 4.8 wrote ZFA:0000140, which is the pancreas).
D9 develops-from row. 8.5 to 8.7 mm SL (748 to 767 hpf); Parichy et al. 2009 pelvic fin ray stage.
